授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This course briefly covers a wide range of topics related to chemistry, engineering, and agriculture. It provides a necessary foundation for specialist studies. That wide range does, however, require a significant effort for passing the exam. Though the title is 'Basic' chemistry, the course is not easy. Students that already have a good high school level understanding of chemistry should not be complacent – THERE HAS NEVER BEEN A YEAR WHEN ALL CHEMISTRY MAJORS GAINED THE TOP GRADE.
Students will arrive on time, will have made trips to the toilet before arriving, and generally behave like adults (I know I shouldn't have to explain this...)
For ISI students taking Basic Chemistry as an optional course: passing this course will require a significant effort at personal study.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Students will learn a broad range of chemical concepts of relevance to all engineering subjects. The level should be appropriate for those that have only studied some basic chemistry at high school.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Fluency in English. Some basic chemistry knowledge is very helpful.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.定期試験: Mid-term exam at end of first quarter, final exam at end of second quarter.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.小テスト: No. Except when I ask questions directly to students where I expect a short answer. But nothing written down.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: No. Students that do not attend always perform badly in the exams. If you want a good grade, attend.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: Your mark will come exclusively from your exam performance. I GIVE PLENTY OF HINTS THROUGH THE COURSE SO PAY ATTENTION.
